Subject: Re: Fwd: High latency observed on /v1/generate - need triage + customer update

Seeing the same signal in our metrics. Quick notes from SRE triage:
- Spike started ~09:03 PST and correlates with increased queue depth on pool-redwood-dedicated-usw-12 (Acme's reserved pool).
- Autoscaler appears to be thrashing: several pods hit high mem pressure and restarted between 09:06–09:18; we also see elevated per-token latency during pod restarts.
- No obvious network failures between frontends and model hosts.

Immediate mitigation options (ranked):
1) Route Acme traffic to model-compact-v2 (compatible model variant with lower memory footprint) — low risk, immediate.
2) Increase min replicas for Acme pool + temporarily relax autoscaler thresholds — medium risk, requires infra change but buys stability.
3) Force a rolling restart with pre-warmed pods — higher latency during restart window.

I recommend option 1 now (we can do server-side routing change in ~10–15m) and option 2 as a follow-up for durability. Need Dev to prepare a one-line safe routing override and confirm any compatibility caveats. Also attaching a snippet of the autoscale playbook for quick reference.

Attachment: [playbook_autoscale_snippet.md (text, 4KB)]

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior SRE Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: evelyn_hart@redwood.com, rachel_kim@redwood.com
Date: 2026-02-14T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: High latency observed on /v1/generate - need triage + customer update

Thanks — triage notes + action plan:
- Root cause: memory pressure on model-hosts serving the large variant (model-accurate-v3) combined with aggressive autoscaler cool-downs causing capacity oscillations.
- Short-term mitigation: implement routing override to model-compact-v2 for Acme's tenant-id (safe for their workload; small perf delta). I can push the routing rule to prod in ~20–30 minutes with a quick config change.
- Medium-term: bump min_replicas for dedicated pools and increase cooldown window to prevent thrash. Will open a change with infra and schedule codeline change for next release.

Planned steps now:
1) Push routing override (10:30–10:40)
2) Monitor latency/throughput for 30m; if stable, keep override for 2h then revert once autoscaler changes are in place.
3) If override fails, rollback and roll a set of pre-warmed pods (contingency).

I'll push the config and post a status update when complete.

—Dev
Dev Patel
SRE/Backend Engineer, Redwood Inference

Subject: Update: short-term mitigation in progress for latency spike (Acme)

Tom —

Quick update from the team: we identified a capacity/autoscaling instability affecting your dedicated pool and are routing your traffic to a compatible lower-memory model variant (model-compact-v2) as a temporary mitigation. We expect the routing change to complete by ~10:45 PST and will monitor for 30–60 minutes.

Why this helps: the compact model reduces memory pressure and prevents pod restarts that appear to be causing your elevated tail latency.

Next updates:
- If the mitigation stabilizes metrics, we'll keep the override in place for up to 2 hours while we harden autoscaling rules.
- If we need more time we'll follow up with ETA for a longer fix.

Apologies for the disruption — we know this impacts your users. I'll be in touch with another status update within the hour.

Hannah Schmitt
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>

Subject: Post-incident note & next steps: Acme latency spike (Feb 14)

Team — thanks for the rapid response and the clear playbook execution. Quick post-incident summary and asks for PM/Eng roadmap:
- Timeline: spike observed 09:03; routing override to model-compact-v2 completed 10:38; metrics normalized by ~10:55; we kept override in place until 12:30 while autoscaler cooldown changes were rolled to canary.
- Impact: customer-facing errors reduced to <0.1% after mitigation; 95th pct latency returned to ~480ms.
- Root cause: autoscaler cooldown too short combined with memory footprint variance between model variants.

Action items (owner / ETA):
- dev_patel: open INF ticket to make min_replicas configurable per-dedicated-pool and set sane defaults (ETA: 2w).
- vivek_kulkarni: own autoscaler tuning PR and run canary (ETA: 1w).
- evelyn_hart: work with product on roadmap slot for autoscaler improvements and model-variant profiling to prevent regressions (ETA: next planning cycle).
- hannah_schmitt/rachel_kim: finalize customer postmortem language and share with legal if needed (ETA: EOD).

I've attached a quick KPI export from the monitoring job. Please add any missing notes to the postmortem doc at the linked Drive.
